recorder.label: Launch
recorder.note: Void One and two wingmen leave the carrier group.

recorder.label: Wave 1 and the first lock
recorder.note: Two Razors, then two more. The lock builds while the target stays centred.

recorder.label: Wave 1 cleared, a rock splits
recorder.note: Shot rocks break into smaller ones.

recorder.label: Wave 2: Razors and Mauls
recorder.note: A Razor at close range; the bombers come in pincer pairs.

recorder.label: A Maul up close
recorder.note: Heavy plasma on long strafing runs.

recorder.label: The Leviathan jumps in
recorder.note: The carrier arrives behind its shield.

recorder.label: First generator down
recorder.note: One of four, on pylons outside the shield bubble.

recorder.label: Chain reaction
recorder.note: The last generator goes and the carrier comes apart.

recorder.label: Mission report
recorder.note: Time, kills, accuracy and a rank.
